title: Projects screen: DropTarget's Select files button is an orphan 69 x 17 px control
description:
Found in the agent-a6ec review pass of T149 (N4). T149's approval stands; this is a follow-up, not a rejection.

DEFECT. N4 wrapped the Projects screen's project list in DropTarget, and DropTarget always renders its keyboard path, button.select-files ("Select files"). On the Projects screen that button is an orphan control:
- Measured on the recorded N4 build (node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui3-n4/dist-live) at 1440 x 900, 2x, light and dark: box 69 x 17 CSS px at (1051, 305). That is under the 24 x 24 minimum this wave set for controls and far under the 32 px --control-height every other control in that row uses.
- It floats at the right edge between "No projects yet." and the storage note, with no label saying what it selects or where the files go (screenshot: node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/a6ec-n4-review/shots/projects-idle-light.png and -dark.png).
- Its accessible name is "Select files" with no context, on a screen whose action is importing writing.
- Cause: src/components/drop-target.css gives .select-files only a font-size and colour; DropTarget hardcodes the label "Select files"; ProjectLibrary renders the DropTarget around the whole list, so the button lands in the list flow.

SUGGESTED FIX (either is acceptable; keep the DropTarget outline and states as they are):
(a) Let DropTarget take a label for its button (e.g. selectLabel) and place the Projects one in the toolbar row beside "Start new project" as a text button at --control-height, reading "Import writing" to match the importer; or
(b) keep it inside the region but give it the shared text-button treatment at --control-height, right-aligned on its own row, with aria-label "Import writing (text, Markdown, Word, HTML or a .zip bundle)".

ACCEPTANCE. The Projects screen's import control measures at least 32 px tall, sits in a labelled position, has an accessible name that says what it imports, and the keyboard path still opens the picker and imports the chosen file (tests/drop-target.spec.ts "Select files on the Projects list opens the picker and imports the chosen file" must still pass). The Research PDF slot keeps its own label.

FILES. src/components/DropTarget.tsx, src/components/drop-target.css, src/components/library.css, src/components/ProjectLibrary.tsx, tests/drop-target.spec.ts. Coordinate with T157, which also touches DropTarget.tsx and ResearchPanel.tsx for the native PDF command; re-read those files before editing.

EVIDENCE. Screenshots and the measurement are in node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/a6ec-n4-review/. Chromium only.

Viewed projects-import-dark.png: button reads Import writing beside Start new project, same row, muted text, no grey box. Fail-first on the N4 build (ui3-n4/dist-live): both new tests fail (toHaveText / element not found). New build: tsc 0; vitest src/components 28/28; Playwright drop-target, projects-screen, research-pdf, alignment 55/55 (pw-new.log). Evidence in node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui3-selectfiles (pw-failfirst-pre.log, pw-new.log, build.log, shots/projects-import-light.png and projects-import-dark.png viewed: button reads Import writing beside Start new project, same row, muted text, no grey box). Not run: native WebKit, cargo, full suite.
